newsitem.title: USA: Performance Food to acquire W.J Powell Co.
newsitem.headline: Performance Food to acquire W.J Powell Co.

text.p: Performance Food Group Co said Wednesday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the outstanding stock of W.J. Powell Co Inc, a privately owned, food service distributor based in Thomasville, Georgia.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

This acquisition, said Performance, is its fourth in fiscal 1997, and will expand its geographic coverage in the southeast, filling a market area contiguous to its operations in Atlanta; Tampa, Florida; and Houma, La.
W.J. Powell reported 1996 sales of approximately $44 million. Performance Food Group reported net sales of $784
million. It distributes food to about 16,000 restaurants, hotels, cafeterias, schools, healthcare facilities and other institutions.
